purpose: Teach: 現われる/送れる/盛り上げる/おのずと/歩き回っ/さらい/か所/ソクラテス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、夜空に、絶対、流れ星、絶対、現われる、絶対、瞬間、絶対、見たいわ
lines.en: Sho, I really and truly want to see a shooting star appear in the night sky with you — I mean it.
lines.style: Gentle, almost vulnerable earnestness. Soft attack on the opening name. Slow cadence, lingering on the image of the shooting star. Trailing warmth at the end — she means every word and needs him to know that.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、メイ姉さんに、絶対、絵手紙、絶対、送れる、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really, truly promise — I'm going to send you a picture letter. I really mean it.
lines.style: Quiet, steady conviction. Small voice but unshakeable. No rush to the words. A child making a solemn vow he intends to keep.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、翔くんの誕生日、絶対、盛り上げる、絶対、ために、絶対、準備、絶対、するわ
lines.en: Sho, I promise you — I'm going to make your birthday special. I'm going to prepare everything. I really mean it.
lines.style: Bright, purposeful energy. Quick forward momentum on the promises. Warm and almost eager — this matters to her. Not breathless, but animated with genuine intention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、頑張れば、絶対、おのずと、絶対、結果は、絶対、ついてくるよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, if I try my very best, the results will follow naturally — right?
lines.style: Earnest, slightly searching. A child working through something he's learned and testing it against what he feels. Open and honest, not quite questioning but not entirely certain either.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、公園を、絶対、歩き回って、絶対、お花、絶対、観察したのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I walked all through the park observing the flowers — I really did, just for you.
lines.style: Animated, almost proud. Slight emphasis on the effort — she wants him to feel the care behind it. Warm delivery, as if sharing something precious she's discovered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、お勉強、絶対、おさらい、絶対、毎日、絶対、してるよ、メイ姉さん
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm studying and reviewing every single day — I really am.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Steady, earnest cadence. A child reporting his own discipline without boasting — just wanting her to know he's keeping his promise to himself and to her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、近所の、絶対、二か所、絶対、お気に入りの、絶対、お店、絶対、あるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, there are two little shops nearby that are my favorites — places I want to share with you.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Slight pause before naming them — she's choosing which memories to invite him into. Tender and deliberate, as if unlocking something personal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、絵本で、絶対、ソクラテス、絶対、見たことあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've actually seen Socrates in a picture book before — isn't that cool?
lines.style: Bright, eager discovery. Quick, animated delivery. A child excited to share something he's learned and connect it to her world. Genuine wonder without pretense.
